name: Karthik Narasimhan

affiliations.role: Associate professor, co-author of SWE-bench and Tree of Thoughts

bio: Karthik Narasimhan is an associate professor of computer science at Princeton University, working on language agents. They are a co-author of SWE-bench, a benchmark of real GitHub issues for software engineering agents, and of ReAct and Tree of Thoughts. Narasimhan also served as head of research at Sierra.
known_for: Co-author of ReAct and Tree of Thoughts
Research on language agents at Princeton
